name: MegaRobotics M100WS
summary: A wheel-legged carrier of 79 kg that the German MegaRobotics brand rates for 100 kg continuous payload while moving and up to 7.5 h unloaded, IP67, built by an OEM partner. Payloads such as sensors, lights or equipment are fitted per project.
